resources.string: Grant camera and microphone permission, choose a camera mode, and start recording.
Dual mode attempts front and rear recording at the same time. Full dual preview and recording still depends on the device concurrent-camera hardware support.

Android 12+ may block camera startup directly from the background. If that happens, the app will show a notification for a user-confirmed start.
Preview stays hidden by default to mimic a dashcam. Turn this on only when you need to check framing.
When dual mode is active, the front camera preview stays in the top bar and the rear camera preview fills the lower panel in both portrait and landscape.
